name: World Ender
source:
Nik, the protagonist finds himself chained and trapped in an abandoned demon temple.
Kira, the god of demons that disappeared a thousand years ago is the only one that has been talking to him.
Why did the humans leave him there?
Are demons the real monsters afterall?

[From [url=https://nikvn.itch.io/world-ender]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主人公Nik发现自己被锁链束缚，困在一座废弃的恶魔神殿里。
一千年前消失的恶魔之神Kira，是唯一一直与他说话的存在。
人类为什么把他留在这里？
恶魔，真的是怪物吗？

[摘自[url=https://nikvn.itch.io/world-ender]itch.io[/url]]
